decision.note: Current Kew accepts O. azurea but gives a native range in Mexico, not Texas. Older Texas 'azurea' concepts overlap taxa now treated differently, including O. aureispina. Do not install O. azurea as a Texas native learner entry from the old source-row name.

learner_guardrail: Do not create duplicate canonical taxa from parent names, synonyms, or stale infraspecific concepts. Current accepted concept and project counting unit control installation.
